- Confirm co-branding placement (logo + short blurb)
- Share a proposed 5-email invite cadence (save-the-date, main invite, two reminders, last-chance)

Thanks for the note, Asha — excited about this. Marissa and Ben are looping in to own invite copy and tracking.

Quick proposal (high level):
- Cadence (5 emails over 3 weeks):
  1) Save-the-date (short, opt-in CTA) — send Day 0
  2) Main invite (value props, speakers, 45-min format) — Day 3
  3) Tech deep-dive reminder (call out infra-specific takeaways) — Day 10
  4) Hot-lead nudge (only to people who clicked or are in product-fit segments) — Day 17
  5) Last chance + calendar add (12–24 hours before) — Day 21

- RSVP priority / heatmap idea: tag recipients by intent signals (click, browsing product pages, trial sign-up). Hot segment gets an extra nudge and a short subject line variant.
- Tracking: we'll hand off a tracking_map.csv with final RSVP URL + UTM params (utm_source=acme, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=acme-rag-webinar-202611). We'll also provide a short link per cohort for click attribution.

Attachments: I'm sharing a draft invite_sequence_v1.xlsx and the tracking_map.csv for your events team to review.

Questions for you:
- Any mandatory legal/brand text for co-branding?
- Do you want Redwood to handle registration landing page (we can host) or point to your registration?

If it's helpful, Marissa can push final copy by Thursday and Ben will own link instrumentation.

Thanks,
Mateo
VP Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwoodinference.com

Looping through a quick ops plan. Keeping this internal until Asha signs off on branding positions.

- Ben: instrument UTM patterns and set expirations for one-time-use links.

- Warm: opened but no click -> standard reminders
- Cold: baseline cadence, lighter copy

I'll also add a tracking column in the sheet for "preferred outreach owner" so SDRs can follow up post-webinar.
